rows.label: Two First-Year Writing Seminars

source.anchor: College of Arts and Sciences Graduation Requirements

rows.note: A seminar is any course titled 'FWS:' or ENGL 2860 / ENGL 2880. Exclusive: a seminar used here counts toward nothing else. The AP English / IB English route to one seminar needs an exam score the board does not hold, so it is not encoded (confirm with an advisor).

rows.label: All ten distribution categories, from at least 8 courses

source.anchor: College of Arts and Sciences Graduation Requirements

rows.note: Eligible courses carry 3+ credits, are not variable credit, and are not AP/IB/transfer/placement credit. A course fills at most 2 categories and at most 2 courses may fill two. External transfers' regular-semester coursework can count per the catalog; the format cannot see that, so all transfer credit is excluded (conservative).

rows.label: Foreign language (Option 1 or Option 2)
rows.note: Overlay: language courses may also fill distribution or major rows. AP/IB credit never completes it. The native-competence exemption is not checkable (confirm with an advisor).

rows.label: Option 1: one FLOPI-AS course at the 2000 level or above, 3+ credits
Option 2: 11 credits in one language at Cornell
rows.note: One subject stands in for one language. Only single-language subjects are listed (multi-language subjects such as ASRC, CLASS, JWST are left out) and only courses tagged FL-AG, FLOPI-AS or OCL-IL count, so English-taught courses in a language department do not. The course-sequence condition is not checkable.

rows.label: 120 academic credits
rows.note: AP/IB/transfer credit counts toward the total. Physical education is excluded; the other non-credit categories (precalculus, supplemental, ESL and similar) have no roster marker and are not excluded here, so check them with an advisor.

rows.label: 100 of the credits taken in Arts and Sciences
rows.note: Course records carry no college-of-offering field, so this cannot be computed from board data. AP/IB/test credit does not count toward it.

rows.label: 80 credits taken for a letter grade
Full-time semesters in residence
rows.note: At least six full-time residence semesters (four for external transfers), with the final semester in residence.

rows.label: Two physical education courses and the swim test
rows.note: A university requirement; PE credit does not count toward the 120 academic credits.
